questions.content: Câu 1: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. I woke up. I saw that it was snowing.
options: A. When I woke up, I saw that it was snowing.
B. If I woke up, I saw that it was snowing.
C. Seeing that it was snowing, I woke up.
D. I saw that it was snowing before I woke up.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Hai câu gốc diễn tả hành động nối tiếp (Tôi thức dậy → Tôi thấy tuyết rơi). Câu A dùng "When" để nối đúng ý. Dịch nghĩa: Khi tôi thức dậy, tôi thấy rằng tuyết đang rơi.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. Because the house was damaged, nobody lived in it.
options: A. Nobody wanted to live in the damaged house.
B. Because nobody lived in the house, it was damaged.
C. The house was damaged, although it was occupied.
D. The house was not occupied as it was damaged.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Câu gốc có vế 1 là nguyên nhân dẫn đến vế 2. Dịch nghĩa: Vì ngôi nhà bị hư hại nên không có ai sống ở đó.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. My brother wishes he had a sports bike.
options: A. My brother once had a sports bike.
B. A sports bike is what my brother doesn't like.
C. At present my brother doesn't have a sports bike.
D. At present my brother doesn't need a sports bike.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: "Wish + past simple" → diễn tả điều không có thật ở hiện tại. Nghĩa: Anh trai tôi ước có một chiếc xe thể thao. → thực tế: anh ấy không có. Dịch nghĩa: Hiện tại anh trai tôi không có một chiếc xe thể thao.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. It's a pity that we do not have a long summer holiday.
options: A. I wish we have a long summer holiday.
B. I wish we had a long summer holiday.
C. Having a long summer holiday is a pity.
D. Having a long summer holiday is a must.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Câu gốc: “Thật tiếc là chúng tôi không có kì nghỉ hè dài.” → dùng cấu trúc wish + past simple để diễn tả điều ước trái với hiện tại. Dịch nghĩa: Tôi ước chúng tôi có một kì nghỉ hè dài.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. Mai was studying. Her mum didn't want to bother her.
options: A. Mai was studying when her mum didn't want to bother her.
B. Her mum didn't want to bother Mai while she was studying.
C. After Mai was studying, her mum didn't want to bother her.
D. Her mum didn't want to bother Mai but she was studying.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Câu gốc: "Mai đang học. Mẹ cô ấy không muốn làm phiền cô ấy." → Dùng while để nối: “Mẹ không muốn làm phiền Mai khi cô ấy đang học.” Dịch nghĩa: Mẹ của Mai không muốn làm phiền cô ấy trong khi cô ấy đang học.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world.
options: A. No other religious building in the world is as large as Angkor Wat.
B. All other religious monuments in the world are larger than Angkor Wat.
C. No other religious monument in the world is as large as Angkor Wat.
D. No other religious building in the world is larger than Angkor Wat.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Viết lại so sánh nhất bằng cấu trúc: No other + danh từ + is as + adj + as…; dùng đúng từ “monument” như câu gốc. Dịch nghĩa: Không có công trình tôn giáo nào trên thế giới lớn bằng Angkor Wat.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. Dinh Bang Communal house, a 300-year-old communal house, was built for 36 years.
options: A. Dinh Bang Communal house is a 300-year-old communal house, that were built for 36 years.
B. Dinh Bang Communal house, which is a 300-year-old communal house, was built for 36 years.
C. Dinh Bang Communal house, what is a 300-year-old communal house, was built for 36 years.
D. Dinh Bang Communal house, was built for 36 years, is a 300-year-old communal house.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định dùng “which is …” để bổ sung thông tin; chia was (số ít) đúng chủ ngữ “house”. Dịch nghĩa: Đình Bảng, một ngôi đình 300 năm tuổi, được xây dựng trong 36 năm.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose A, B, C, or D to indicate the sentence that is closest in meaning to the sentence given. Windsor Castle was built a thousand years ago and is the home for about 40 English kings and queens.
options: A. Windsor Castle, which was built a thousand years ago, is the home for about 40 English kings and queens.
B. Windsor Castle, was built a thousand years before, but it is the home for about 40 English kings and queens.
C. Windsor Castle, was built a thousand years ago, so it is the home for about 40 English kings and queens.
D. Windsor Castle, was built in a thousand years, and is the home for about 40 English kings and queens.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Dùng mệnh đề quan hệ “which was built a thousand years ago” để gộp hai mệnh đề. Dịch nghĩa: Lâu đài Windsor, được xây cách đây một nghìn năm, là nơi ở của khoảng 40 vị vua và hoàng hậu Anh.
